# Independent audit: one-sided pointed marginal below Gamma_2

Audited source: `candidate ef093ba9b166b4a3`.

**PASS.** The endpoint midpoint fiber is (21/200)D+(89/100)v_0, contained in D because the coefficients sum to 199/200 and the remaining coefficient can multiply the centroid 0. Hence the canonical convex hull preserves all three positive integer fibers. The projecting apex (1,0) is strictly interior to its small positive fiber.

The projection x=(1-z)xi has Jacobian 4 at z=-1, giving exactly f=1_D+4·1_T and mass (26/25)|D|. The missing affine coefficient in T=.1D+.89v_0 contributes .01/3 to each barycentric coordinate, so its bounds lambda_0>=67/75 and lambda_1,lambda_2<=31/300 are correct.

The three thresholds sum to one, so their closed halfspaces cover all of D. T is wholly inside the first and disjoint from the other two. The simplex cap formulas yield the displayed equal masses because t solves 3t^2-10t+79/25=0. The strict comparison to 4/9 reduces to 154449<155200 after squaring positive quantities. No approximation or numerical evidence enters the certificate.

The original one-sided projection is therefore insufficient for an ordinary Gamma_2 marginal theorem, even with consecutive positive fibers and an interior apex. The example supplies neither actual global deepestness of that apex nor two propagated critical source menus, and it does not challenge OC.
